in_tamil.name: Hiralal
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Radiant, Shining, Light
in_tamil.long_meaning: Hiralal ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Hira means 'shining, radiant, or jewel'. Lal means 'red' or 'the one who removes sorrows'. Thus, Hiralal is the one who shines and removes sorrows.

in_telugu.name: Hiralal
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Radiant, Shining, Light
in_telugu.long_meaning: Hiralal ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Hira means 'shining, radiant, or jewel'. Lal means 'red' or 'the one who removes sorrows'. Thus, Hiralal is the one who shines and removes sorrows.

in_marathi.name: Hiralal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant, Shining, Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hiralal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hira means 'shining, radiant, or jewel'. Lal means 'red' or 'the one who removes sorrows'. Thus, Hiralal is the one who shines and removes sorrows.

in_bengali.name: Hiralal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Radiant, Shining, Light
in_bengali.long_meaning: Hiralal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Hira means 'shining, radiant, or jewel'. Lal means 'red' or 'the one who removes sorrows'. Thus, Hiralal is the one who shines and removes sorrows.
